blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

Jared's take on Morgan Creek

Bigger lots and custom homes on a golf course define Morgan Creek, an established community. Golfers love it, downsizers come here from larger South Surrey houses, and families look at Morgan Elementary, Rosemary Heights Elementary or Southridge.

blocks.text: What Morgan Creek homes sold for

Between November 7, 2025 and November 6, 2026, 48 detached houses sold in Morgan Creek at a median of $1,915,000, 43 townhomes at $790,000 and 36 condos at $550,000. In the last six months (May 7 to November 6, 2026), 17 detached houses sold at a median of $1,800,000. The latest sale in the pull was on October 28, 2026.

faq.q: Is Rosemary Heights part of Morgan Creek?
faq.a: On MLS®, yes: the Morgan Creek sub-area includes both the golf course neighbourhood and Rosemary Heights, while the City treats Rosemary Heights as its own planning area with Central and West neighbourhood concept plans

faq.q: Do I need to belong to the golf club to live in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: No — Morgan Creek Golf Course at 3500 Morgan Creek Way describes itself as a public golf course, so living here is not tied to golf; ask the course directly about membership or course access

faq.q: Which schools are in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: Schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file inside this sub-area's ground are Morgan Elementary (3366 156a St) and Rosemary Heights Elementary (15516 36 Ave), with Grandview Heights Secondary at 16987 25 Ave — but catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the SD36 locator before relying on a school (BC Ministry K-12 file)

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 45 houses listed with 1 sold in the month and 34 condos and townhomes listed with 6 sold in the month in Morgan Creek. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Morgan Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 2%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 18%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
